Standard state.subject: Agronomy & Crop Production

Standard state.fact: The standard state of a material (pure substance, mixture or solution) is a reference point used to calculate its properties under different conditions. The GSRS uses molecular structure, protein and nucleic sequences and descriptive information to generate the UNII.
